products.label: Local Volume Database v1.1.1
products.process: Select eligible published rows, resolve membership and citations, and convert adopted angles and distances to Cartesian metres.
limitations: Catalogue candidates remain candidates; the navigation epoch is not a measurement epoch.

products.label: Sparse Local Group context sample
products.process: Select at most 48 catalogue-only Local Group entries in 150 kpc cells weighted by square-root counts; preserve catalogue positions.
limitations: Illustrative display density is not mass density or catalogue completeness; all eligible catalogue subjects remain navigable.
